About the job

WE ARE HIRING | SERVICE TECHNICIANS

Company: Sudanese Tractor Company Limited (SUTRAC) – Engineering Division – DAL Group

SUTRAC is Sudan’s sole authorized Caterpillar dealer for heavy machinery and electric power generation.




OPEN POSITIONS

🔧 Service Technician LII – Mechanic

 ⚡ Service Technician LII – Electrician

📍 Job Location: Sudan – Field Based

👤 Reporting To: Service Supervisor

 

Position Purpose:

To perform mechanical and electrical troubleshooting, diagnostics, maintenance, and repair of CAT heavy equipment and power-generation systems, ensuring repairs are completed safely, efficiently, and to Caterpillar standards, within the optimum time and cost to achieve reliable equipment performance and customer satisfaction.

 

Key Accountabilities:

· Heavy Equipment & Power Generation Maintenance & Repair

· Genset Technical Support & Maintenance; Perform troubleshooting, diagnostics, testing, maintenance, and repair of diesel generator sets (gensets), including engines and related power-generation systems, ensuring faults are accurately identified and repairs are completed in accordance with Caterpillar standards and manufacturer specifications.

· Parts Ordering; Determine re-usability of parts in accordance with published Caterpillar re-usability guidelines.

· Equipment Management; Clean, repair, recondition and maintain equipment and components.

· Job Tracking; Record all the work carried out in the job card, sort & dispose or keep replaced parts in the right place to assist in better operation management.

· Tools; Keep up to date with developments in tooling, technologies and systems, prepare the tools, equipment & organize the working area and facility as well as perform regular inspections to ensure optimum utilization

· Achieve Targets; Meet the targeted productivity hours average to achieve business profitability and market growth.

· Communication & Job Documentation; Communicate problems and nature of repair and job status to supervisors, accurately prepare service reports in timely manner.

· Punctuality; Follow clear verbal and written instructions, attend work on time

· Policy; Apply all company policies and procedures.

· Quality Assurance; Uses manufacturer diagnostic equipment’s to ensure diagnosis, testing, and repairs are thorough to achieve highest quality.

· HSE; Adhere to all HSE procedures and policies specified for service, operation or repair of equipment's or service tools usage in order to avoid any harm and to achieve a safe environment.

· Coaching Subordinates; providing technical advice to technician’s level I & apprentices and following the repair. 

 

Formal Qualifications & Certification: 

· Vocational Training Center Certificate or secondary school.

Experience:

· Minimum 3 - 5 years in field technician, with good experience on CAT heavy equipment

· Experience in CAT engine troubleshooting and overhauling

· Experience with diesel generator sets (gensets) and power-generation equipment

 

How to Apply:

Interested candidates are invited to send their updated CV to:

📧 recruit.ded@dalgroup.com 

Only shortlisted candidates will be contacted.
